description: Header file defining classes, functions, and enums for multiplayer UI in Wesnoth, including chat management, network handling, and UI layout.

classes.name: mp::chat
classes.description: Manages chat messages and message history within multiplayer sessions.

classes.name: mp::ui
classes.description: Base class for multiplayer dialog interfaces, handling network data, user interactions, and layout.

methods.name: mp::chat::add_message
methods.description: Adds a new message to the chat history.

methods.name: mp::chat::init_textbox
methods.description: Initializes a GUI textbox for chat display.

methods.name: mp::chat::update_textbox
methods.description: Updates the GUI textbox with current chat messages.

methods.name: mp::chat::format_message
methods.description: Formats a chat message for display.

methods.name: mp::ui::process_network
methods.description: Handles incoming network data and errors.

methods.name: mp::ui::get_result
methods.description: Returns the current result/state of the UI dialog.

methods.name: mp::ui::set_location
methods.description: Sets the position and size of the UI widget.

methods.name: mp::ui::draw_contents
methods.description: Draws the UI contents; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: mp::ui::process_event
methods.description: Handles user input events.

methods.name: mp::ui::handle_event
methods.description: Processes specific SDL events.

methods.name: mp::ui::handle_key_event
methods.description: Processes keyboard events.

methods.name: mp::ui::process_network_data
methods.description: Processes received network data; override for custom behavior.

methods.name: mp::ui::process_network_error
methods.description: Handles network errors; override for custom behavior.

methods.name: mp::ui::accept_connections
methods.description: Determines if incoming network connections are accepted.

methods.name: mp::ui::process_network_connection
methods.description: Handles new incoming network connections.

methods.name: mp::ui::hide_children
methods.description: Hides or shows child widgets.

methods.name: mp::ui::layout_children
methods.description: Arranges child widgets within the UI.

methods.name: mp::ui::set_result
methods.description: Sets the current result/state of the UI dialog.

methods.name: mp::ui::gamelist_updated
methods.description: Called when the game list is updated.

methods.name: mp::ui::set_user_list
methods.description: Updates the list of users.
